title: Salesforce Developer - SoftServe
summary:
In SoftServe I was working in a project for a payment provider based in England, there I contribute to improving/customizing the quoting process for the company's clients where I leverage my knowledge in LWC, Salesforce CPQ, Apex, Flows and OmniScripts to create better UI experience and automations.

 Some of my time in SoftServe I was in a standby period awaiting client allocation. Instead of remaining passive, I proactively utilized the time to bridge the gap between Salesforce and core soware engineering. I focused on Design Patterns, OAuth, and deep understanding of Java/OOP principles to ensure I can build architecturally sound solutions, regardless of the platform.
bullets: Customized Salesforce CPQ quoting process for clients leveraginf LWC, Apex, Flows and OmniScripts.
Was part of a 30+ team of Salesforce developers and engineers, collaborating and sharing knowledge.
